scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-consumer && npm install --prefix services/duplicate-detector
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT,RECO,NOTIFY -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix services/recommendation-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/notification-consumer"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm run build --prefix services/notification-consumer && npm run build --prefix services/duplicate-detector
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm run typecheck --prefix services/notification-consumer && npm run typecheck --prefix services/duplicate-detector
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm test --prefix services/notification-consumer
